#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Inspect original Cocoa plugin category/class identity; not a build pass."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse,hashlib,json,re,runpy,shlex,subprocess,tempfile
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent;p=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__);p.add_argument('--configuration',required=True);p.add_argument('--stage',required=True);a=p.parse_args()
folder=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='ib-cocoa-category-',dir=root/'runtime'));sdk=root/'runtime/state/prefix/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer/Platforms/MacOSX.platform/Developer/SDKs/MacOSX.sdk';source='fixtures/hello/ib-cocoa-category.c';obj=folder/'test.o';program=folder/'test'
for c in [['clang-19','-target','x86_64-apple-macos11','-isysroot',str(sdk),'-O2','-c',str(root/source),'-o',str(obj)],['ld64.lld-19','-arch','x86_64','-platform_version','macos','11','11','-syslibroot',str(sdk),'-lSystem','-lobjc','-no_fixup_chains','-no_adhoc_codesign',str(obj),'-o',str(program)]]:subprocess.run(c,cwd=root,check=True)
module=runpy.run_path(str(root/'scripts/direct-resource-tool-runtime-profile.py'));profile=module['profile'](stage=a.stage,configuration=a.configuration);env=module['environment'](profile)
for n in ['DISPLAY','WAYLAND_DISPLAY','XAUTHORITY']:env.pop(n,None)
plugin='/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/PlugIns/IDEInterfaceBuilderCocoaIntegration.framework/Versions/A/IDEInterfaceBuilderCocoaIntegration';guest=lambda p:'/Volumes/SystemRoot/workspace/'+str(p.relative_to(root));script=folder/'run.sh';script.write_text('#!/bin/bash\nulimit -c 0\nunset DISPLAY WAYLAND_DISPLAY XAUTHORITY\n'+shlex.join([guest(program),plugin])+'\nstatus=$?\nprintf "COCOA_CATEGORY_STATUS %s\\n" "$status"\nexit "$status"\n')
command=profile['command'][:-2]+['/bin/bash',guest(script)];command[3]='120';log=folder/'native.log'
with log.open('w') as out:result=subprocess.run(command,cwd=root,env=env,stdout=out,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
text=log.read_text();sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest();report=dict(diagnostic_only=True,diagnostic_completed=result.returncode==0 and 'COCOA_CATEGORY_DIAGNOSTIC_COMPLETE' in text,outer_status=result.returncode,command=command,log=str(log.relative_to(root)),log_sha256=sha(log),configuration=a.configuration,stage=a.stage,sources={str(p.relative_to(root)):sha(p) for p in [Path(__file__),root/source,root/('runtime/state/prefix'+plugin)]},resource_compilation_verified=False,full_goal_complete=False)
(folder/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n');print(text);print('EVIDENCE',folder/'result.json');raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
